name: Arm circles (test F - trail runner woods)
prompt: A trail runner pauses on a forest trail to do a simple arm-circle stretch, standing in place with arms extended out to the sides making continuous controlled circles, full body visible. Sunlight filters through the forest canopy in dappled patches across the trail, tall evergreen trees on both sides, a gentle river visible through the trees in the background, morning mist. Loose, fully-covering outdoor running layers (long sleeves, leggings or joggers). Cinematic, polished outdoor lifestyle video, natural light, shallow depth of field. Vertical video, about 6 seconds, one continuous shot, photorealistic, G-rated, no on-screen text or watermark.
